admitted_operations: recursive composition under the frozen 31 operators; no new operation

domain.candidate_binding: must bind the exact committed G6:S5 stage artifact and candidate-law hash; any change requires review
domain.fresh_holdouts: generated deterministically from the S5 candidate hash after S5 commits, using a preregistered domain-separation rule; holdouts are not used to choose the S5 state
proof_obligations: base generators map into candidate state
direct exact composition projects to the candidate write
induction covers every finite binary term under the frozen grammar

evidence_contract: fresh holdout generator seed/hash and cases
exact_equality_rule: Hashes may index/bind artifacts, but every exact scientific equality claim is decided by full structural equality of the declared carrier/outcome objects.
frozen_question: Given the exact S5 candidate artifact as a hash-bound dependency, does its finite state and write law factor every finite generated G6 term under the frozen 31-operator grammar by structural induction, with independent cold verification and fresh preregistered holdouts?

observer.graduation: mechanical PASS creates a graduation candidate only
observer.primary: factorization equality between exact direct composition projection and abstract recursive write

parent_authority.public_law: enabled iff f_a>0 and g_b>0; D_out=(f+g-e_a-e_b,m+n)

promotion_constraints: Mechanical PASS never changes G5 authority.
Any new G6 public field is candidate-only until S5 earns a finite state and S6 plus explicit graduation review approve it.
Hidden topology/canon/provenance may be used as oracle evidence but cannot enter the public descriptor unless a separately registered promotion test earns it.
G6 graduation requires a separate explicit scientific graduation review after S6; the chain cannot auto-promote.
purpose: Recursive closure, independent verification, and graduation-candidate gate.
stopping_rules: first decisive separator when the stage specifies first-separator stopping
